challenge.better_approach: Considered a withdraw/merge verb on cairn question, the trouble's other candidate. It cleans up after a duplicate; this stops the duplicate from being made. The verb stays as the trouble's residue, on the orchestrator's order.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a question naming Q#n on the same ticket asks Q#n. A hand question may cite Q#n while asking something else. Measured 2026-11-16 over the commons questions/ at origin/main: 17 open (ticket, Q#n) pairs. 5 are named by a hand-opened question (source None): Q#115, 116, 117, 118 and 119. Each opens with its own Q#n and asks it. Two pairs stand twice: Q#119 on e56a68e651c2 (open-059b4201de27 / open-27d456e96db3) and Q#116 on 312be610152e (open-17442cfc2096 / open-e135ce10590f).
challenge.prior_art: _open_what_stands already reuses a question this check opened before (ticket 6541ccd1594c, clause 3). This widens the same reuse to a question of any source for the open-[Q#n] case only.
challenge.real_collision: None. Conflict questions keep their own marker, the outline line's quoted text, which only outline_check writes.

answers.falsifier: Done when a check over a ticket carrying a hand-opened question naming Q#7 opens nothing for Q#7 and names the hand question as already open, while a hand question naming Q#70, or one on another ticket, still lets Q#7 open. Wrong if a hand question naming a Q#n can ask something other than that Q#n; then reuse must read more than the number.
answers.how: In _open_what_stands (outline_check.py), the open-[Q#n] branch reuses any open question on the ticket (Q.open_for) whose text names Q#n as a whole number (Q#7 is not Q#70). The conflict branch keeps its outline_check-only reuse. A red-first proof opens a question by hand on a fixture ticket naming Q#7, runs the check touching Q#7's line, and sees nothing opened and the hand question listed under questions_already_open.

answers.traces_to: Law 1: a question already standing at his gate is a settled ask, and asking it twice spends his attention re-deriving it.
answers.what: cairn outlinecheck opens no second question for an open [Q#n] when an open question on the same ticket already names that Q#n, whoever opened it.
